derivation.exclusion: exclude all 336 retained source coordinates and normalized-text digests before ordering
derivation.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse Unicode whitespace, strip
derivation.ordering: sha256(seed:source_split:source_label_id:normalized_text_sha256), then raw UTF-8 sha256 and source_index only as deterministic collision tie-breakers
derivation.split_policy: per label take first 3 remaining source-train rows as train, next 3 as selection, and first 6 remaining source-test rows as test

exposure.scan_summary: current tracked and ignored text/result roots; oversized non-Banking retained files checked directly for Banking77 identifiers

sources.contribution: 240 prior exposed coordinates/digests plus the prior frozen 96-row split
